question: Do market-neutral cross-sectional momentum and funding carry earn positive net returns on a broad crypto universe, and does combining them with the trend core at equal risk beat the trend core alone?
registration_note: Declared 2026-09-27 before any result. S2 reuses the frozen mexc_xs_mom30_7_dn_v1 rules (selected on 10 coins), so on the 53 v2 coins it is untested; the 53 coins have been seen only by the trend core. S3 is new with a-priori parameters.
universe: 17 crypto-trend-core coins + 53 untouched-coins-holdout-v2 coins; point-in-time (a coin is ranked only once it has data)

strategies.S1_trend_core: DON8 + EMA8, entry inverse-vol, canonical v3.1, equal capital across coins
strategies.S2_xs_momentum: frozen mexc_xs_mom30_7_dn_v1 rules: rank 30-day return, long top quartile, short bottom quartile, dollar neutral, 7-day rebalance
strategies.S3_xs_carry: rank minus trailing 7-day funding: long the lowest-funding quartile, short the highest, dollar neutral, 7-day rebalance

economics.funding: Binance USDT-M history (symbol or 1000-prefixed) as MEXC proxy; charged to all books

combination: S4 = equal-risk blend of S1, S2, S3: each weighted by 1/trailing-90-day vol of its daily returns (days before the rebalance only), rebalanced weekly, normalised to sum 1

pass_rules.S2_or_S3_standalone: mean > 0, Newey-West t >= 2 full sample, and positive Sharpe in both halves
pass_rules.S4_combination: Sharpe > S1 Sharpe in both halves
